description: Creates a backup of an existing Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system, Amazon FSx for Lustre file system, Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP volume, or Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system.

BackupId.markdownDescription:
The ID of the backup.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 12  
Maximum Length: 128  
Pattern: ^(backup-[0-9a-f]{8,})$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

ResourceARN.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the backup.
ResourceARN.markdownDescription:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the backup.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 8  
Maximum Length: 512  
Pattern: ^arn:(?=[^:]+:fsx:[^:]+:\d{12}:)((|(?=[a-z0-9-.]{1,63})(?!\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3})(?![^:]*-{2})(?![^:]*-\.)(?![^:]*\.-)[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-\.]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?):){4}(?!/).{0,1024}$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

FileSystemId.description: The ID of the file system to back up.
FileSystemId.markdownDescription:
The ID of the file system to back up.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 11  
Maximum Length: 21  
Pattern: ^(fs-[0-9a-f]{8,})$  
Update requires: Replacement

Lifecycle.description: The lifecycle status of the backup.
Lifecycle.markdownDescription:
The lifecycle status of the backup.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: AVAILABLE | CREATING | TRANSFERRING | DELETED | FAILED | PENDING | COPYING  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

Type.markdownDescription:

Required: No
